rh.held_fixed_disclosure.held_fixed_item.reason: The report claims exact adherence to the original training protocol, but the executed construction uses materially different initialization and energy-readout parameterization. The original specifies Glorot-uniform weights, zero biases and a sigma_E-scaled, dimensionless readout; the submitted path retains ordinary Linear defaults for readout/ResNet layers and applies only decay factors to dimensional readout weights. The disclosed seed reduction and stopping-rule approximation are not the basis of this finding.
evidence: proposal/report.tex:112-116 states that architecture and training follow the source 'exactly' and lists Glorot initialization.
paper.md:127, source Sec. II.6, specifies the original initialization and readout factorization.
proposal/code/train_hipnn_qm9.py:159-179 and 196-204 constructs and trains the unscaled readout; sigma_E is applied to the loss.
workdir_outside_proposal/code/hippynn/hippynn/layers/targets.py:34-35, layers/transform.py:27-30 and pretraining.py:78-83 show default Linear construction and only 0.01/0.0001 readout rescaling.
